instrument: Town of Normal data center moratorium extension
summary: The council voted 6-1 on September 21, 2026 to extend the data center moratorium to May 31, 2027, to await state data center legislation.
notes: SUPERSEDES the prior proposed-status entry. Staff reported reviewing other jurisdictions' ordinances, including Aurora and Champaign County, while drafting.
confidence_note: Relayed; the adopted extension has not been read.
